tagline: 柯达便携相机，1972 年发布
description: 柯达于1972年推出的便携相机。配备f5.6 lens。快门速度one-speed。使用type No. 110 16mm film cartridges。no direct focusing, just aperture settings possible。

specs.光圈: weather symbols for dark clouds, cloudy, normal, sunny and bright mountain sun, selectable by shifter
specs.对焦: no direct focusing, just aperture settings possible
specs.闪光灯: magicubes connector, reaching from 1.2 metres to 5 metres, depending on selected aperture
